notes.title: Major Language Update: Japanese, Korean, Chinese, & Turkish Now Available!
notes.content:
Major Update: 5 New Languages Added  
Hello everyone,

We’re thrilled to announce our latest Major Update for Forgotten Memories! In response to your amazing feedback, we have now introduced full User Interface and Subtitle support for the following languages:

  
 Japanese  
 Korean  
 Simplified Chinese  
 Traditional Chinese  
 Turkish  


We already support English, Russian, and Ukrainian. With these new additions, even more players around the globe can fully immerse themselves in our world.

We hope you enjoy this update, and we can’t wait to hear your thoughts on the new language options. As always, thank you for your support and for being a part of the Forgotten Memories community!

[hr]

Stay tuned for more updates and happy gaming!
